verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own docs show a few background, event-driven capabilities: budgets can trigger programmatic cost-control responses via Pub/Sub, API hub runs a scheduled metadata sync every 6 hours, and Vertex AI is positioned for building and running agentic systems at scale. However, the general 'automate your workflows' API claim is only a developer building block, and nothing documents a user-facing way to define scheduled or autonomous background automations. missing for 10: a documented scheduler/workflow-automation service for user-defined background jobs, evidence of autonomous agent runs operating unattended, hands-on or independent corroboration.
